title: Centre rejects plea to introduce income-based creamy layer in SC/ST quotas
summary: The Union government has opposed a petition seeking to introduce an income-based 'creamy layer' in the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (SC/ST) reservation policy, arguing that it is not aligned with judicial precedent. The majority of welfare schemes have a means test, ensuring benefits reach those who deserve them. The Centre claims this approach will prevent misuse of reservations. The opposition alleges that the government's stance is an attempt to dilute the quota system.
